acceptance_checks.check_id: A projection can be rebuilt from canonical accepted Events, and a fixture can detect duplicate/gapped/out-of-order/wrong-predecessor stream entries, Artifact digest mismatch, cyclic causal lineage, in-place correction attempts, and evidence self-report masquerading as independent qualification.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: A stream uses positive uint64 stream_seq beginning at 1, incrementing exactly by one for each accepted canonical append, and previous_event_id equals the immediately prior Event in that stream except for sequence 1 where it is absent. Duplicate sequence, gap, wrong predecessor, or conflicting Event ID fails closed.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: ArtifactRef binds canonical Artifact ID, exact revision when metadata matters, SHA-256 digest when bytes are relied on, role, and relevant media/size metadata. Digest mismatch is an explicit integrity failure.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Canonical docs remain consistent with IDENTITY_AND_REVISION_MODEL, RUNTIME_OPERATION_MODEL, ARCHITECTURE, QUALITY_AND_EVIDENCE, DATA_LIFECYCLE_AND_PORTABILITY, SECURITY_MODEL, and P01 registry without preempting S05.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Canonical per-stream ordering comes only from stream identity + stream_seq/predecessor. recorded_at/occurred_at are temporal observations, not authorization or ordering authority; separate streams have no implicit total ordering.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Corrections/supersession/forks create new Events; the prior Event is never mutated. Causal and lineage references are acyclic and do not replace stream order.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Event correlation can bind exact entity revisions plus RequestId/OperationId/GrantId and provenance Event IDs. These correlations are identifiers/evidence context, never authority tokens.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Event remains UUIDv7 immutable revision 1, but Event ID and UUID lexical/time order have no event-order authority. One Event belongs to exactly one typed canonical owner stream.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Event type uses a lowercase dotted provider-neutral grammar. Unknown/unnegotiated event type may be retained as opaque data only when compatibility policy later allows it, but cannot silently mutate a privileged canonical projection.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Evidence is immutable revision 1. A changed claim, binding, observed result, qualifying input, limitation, or implementation revision requires a new Evidence ID.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Evidence records exact claim/subject bindings and source class. Agent/model self-report can explain intent but cannot satisfy a stronger independent gate. Machine/external/human-review evidence identifies the observation/artifact/event basis it actually checked.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Exact implementation passes focused stream-order, lineage-cycle, artifact-integrity, evidence-independence, redaction, and replay/projection adversarial checks plus pnpm check, git diff --check, Diffcipline R2, protected exact-head CI, and post-merge main qualification.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Large or sensitive payloads are referenced as Artifacts rather than duplicated into the Event envelope. Ordinary Event/Evidence records do not persist secret plaintext.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Redaction/exclusion is explicit metadata. Redacted/exported views do not mutate canonical Event/Evidence; transformed bytes receive a new Artifact ID/digest; exclusions preserve that content was withheld and why, without storing secret plaintext in the manifest.
acceptance_checks.detail: Rechecked against the canonical Event/Evidence model, focused stream/lineage/artifact/evidence/redaction adversarial checks, protected PR CI, and post-merge main qualification.
